import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 300005;
    static final int M = 100005;
    static int mod;
    static long[] fac = new long[N];
    static long[] ifac = new long[N];
    static long[][] dp = new long[2][N];

    static long gmin(long x, long y) {
        return x > y ? y : x;
    }

    static long gmax(long x, long y) {
        return x < y ? y : x;
    }

    static long ch(long x, long y) {
        return (x + y) % mod;
    }

    static long exp(long x, int y) {
        long ans = 1;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) {
                ans = ans * x % mod;
            }
            x = x * x % mod;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static long C(int x, int y) {
        return fac[x] * ifac[x - y] % mod * ifac[y] % mod;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();

        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % mod;
        }
        ifac[n] = exp(fac[n], mod - 2);
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
            ifac[i] = ifac[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod;
        }

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(exp(k, n));
            sc.close();
            return;
        }

        long ans = 0;
        dp[0][n] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                dp[i & 1][j] = 0;
            }
            long res = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                long tmp = dp[(i - 1) & 1][j];
                if (tmp == 0) continue;
                int u = j ^ (j & -j);
                for (int k_ = u; k_ > 0; k_ = (k_ - 1) & u) {
                    dp[i & 1][k_] = (dp[i & 1][k_] + tmp * C(j, k_)) % mod;
                }
                res = (res + tmp) % mod;
            }
            ans = (ans + res * ifac[k - i]) % mod;
        }
        ans = ans * fac[k] % mod;
        long result = (exp(k, n) - ans + mod) % mod;
        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }
}
